name: Hottó (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of orange and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hottó: a crowned white and orange shield with blue bends and hoods.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of orange and blue triangles
